title: Stiffly

inlines.v: STIFFLY, adverb 1. Firmly; strongly; as the boughs of a tree stiffly upheld. 2. Rigidly; obstinately; with stubbornness. The doctrine of the infallibility of the church of Rome is stiffly maintained by its adherents.
